messages.text: Could you give me an account of Malcolm Byrne's proposed legislation, identifying the Bills he sponsored and explaining how far the records show each got?

I will check the recorded Bills with Malcolm Byrne as an exact sponsor match, then retrieve the available lifecycle records for those Bills.
